slides.title: Tattoo shop owners: 3 dates that don't last forever
The framed shop license by the front desk has a renewal date.
slides.body: The frame doesn't keep it current.

slides.title: Guest artist in December? Check their license and certs first.
slides.body: Many areas require each artist to hold current credentials.

slides.title: Bloodborne pathogens training from 2023?
slides.body: These certifications often need renewing. Check the date.

slides.title: Ink is permanent. Licenses aren't.
slides.body: CertTrack tracks expiration dates and alerts you before they expire.
